content: The posterior labial arteries are anatomical branches derived from the internal pudendal artery. If you are interested in contributing to this topic, you are encouraged to take over this page and apply to become the Editor-in-Chief for this subject. It is possible for there to be one or more Editors-in-Chief. Additionally, you may apply to serve as an Associate Editor-in-Chief for one of the subtopics listed under this subject. To express your interest in serving as either the Editor-in-Chief for the entire topic or as an Associate Editor-in-Chief for a specific subtopic, please send an email indicating your intent. Be sure to include your curriculum vitae (CV) and/or a biographical sketch as part of your application.
